title: An irreducible monic quadratic excludes integer scalar relations
statement: Let R be a unital, possibly noncommutative ring of characteristic zero, let f ∈ R, and let t,q ∈ ℤ. Suppose f² − t f + q = 0 in R, where integers denote their canonical images, and suppose m² − tm + q ≠ 0 for every integer m. Then for every c,e ∈ ℤ with c ≠ 0, one has c f ≠ e in R.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [Ring R] [CharZero R] (f : R) (t q : ℤ), f ^ 2 - (t : R) * f + (q : R) = 0 → (∀ m : ℤ, m ^ 2 - t * m + q ≠ 0) → ∀ c e : ℤ, c ≠ 0 → (c : R) * f ≠ (e : R)
